captions.hook_line: Not taking your 401(k) match is like turning down a raise 💸
captions.body: Many employers match part of what you save. With a common 50% match up to 6% of pay, saving $3,600 of a $60,000 salary brings $1,800 from your employer: an instant 50% on that money before any growth. Formulas and vesting rules differ, so check your plan. Education, not financial advice.
captions.comment_prompt: Does your job match your 401(k), and how much?

youtube_title: Your 401(k) Match Is a Raise You're Skipping

blocks.narration: Skipping your company's four-oh-one-k match? That is turning down a raise. And plenty of people do it every single year.
